summary.goal: Integrate the existing WorkflowActions.tsx component into PlanEditorPage to connect the UI to the workflow API endpoints (submit, approve, publish)
summary.context: WorkflowActions.tsx exists with 170 lines of fully implemented UI (submit/approve/publish buttons, approval modal with approver name input, loading states, error handling, status display) but is never imported anywhere. The API client functions (submitVersion, approveVersion, publishVersion) also exist. This feature connects these existing pieces.
in_scope: Wire onSubmit/onApprove/onPublish callbacks to API functions
Update local version state after successful workflow transitions
Position WorkflowActions appropriately in the plan header area
out_of_scope: Adding new workflow states or transitions

acceptance_criteria.description: WorkflowActions component is imported and rendered in PlanEditorPage
Draft plans without submitted_at show 'Submit for Review' button
Submitted draft plans show 'Approve' button
Approved plans show 'Publish' button
Published plans show 'Published - Ready for Orchestrator' badge
Clicking Submit calls submitVersion API and updates version state
Clicking Approve opens modal, collects approver name, calls approveVersion API
Clicking Publish calls publishVersion API and updates version state
Approval info (approver name, timestamp) displays after approval
Error states from API failures are displayed to user

views.name: WorkflowActions in Plan Header
views.layout: Inside .plan-header-main, after .plan-meta. Vertical stack within header.
views.placement_rationale: Header placement keeps actions visible without scrolling. Better than footer (requires scroll) or floating (conflicts with existing chat toggle at bottom-right).

states.loading: Active button shows 'Submitting.../Approving.../Publishing...' and is disabled
states.error: div.workflow-error shows inline error message above buttons
states.success: Version state updates, button changes to next action

elements.content: By approving this plan, you confirm that the steps and acceptance criteria are correct and ready for execution.

states.empty_name: Approve button enabled but shows error on click if name empty
states.loading: Approve button shows 'Approving...' and is disabled
states.error: div.workflow-error shows error message in modal

visual_hierarchy.description: Button prominence reflects workflow progression and accountability weight

buttons.rationale: Accountability checkpoint, locks the plan - needs distinct color
Final release, but approval was the key checkpoint

plan_implementation.design_reference: design_spec.views[v001] for header placement, design_spec.visual_hierarchy for button styling

steps.title: Add WorkflowActions import and API imports to PlanEditorPage
steps.description: Import WorkflowActions from @/components and add submitVersion, approveVersion, publishVersion to API imports

acceptance_criteria.description: WorkflowActions imported from '@/components/WorkflowActions'
submitVersion, approveVersion, publishVersion imported from '@/api'

steps.title: Create workflow handler callbacks
steps.description: Create handleSubmit, handleApprove, and handlePublish callbacks that call the API functions and update version state on success

acceptance_criteria.description: handleSubmit calls submitVersion(planId, version.version) and setVersion(result.version)
handleApprove(approver) calls approveVersion(planId, version.version, approver) and setVersion(result.version)
handlePublish calls publishVersion(planId, version.version) and setVersion(result.version)
All handlers use useCallback with proper dependencies [planId, version]

steps.title: Render WorkflowActions in plan header per design_spec.views[v001]
steps.description: Add WorkflowActions component inside .plan-header-main after .plan-meta (per design_spec.views[v001].layout). This header placement keeps actions visible without scrolling - better than footer (requires scroll) or floating (conflicts with chat toggle). Pass version and handler callbacks as props.

acceptance_criteria.description: WorkflowActions rendered inside .plan-header-main div after .plan-meta (design_spec.views[v001].layout)
Props passed: version={version}, onSubmit={handleSubmit}, onApprove={handleApprove}, onPublish={handlePublish}

steps.title: Verify button styling matches design_spec.visual_hierarchy
steps.description: Verify WorkflowActions component uses correct button styling per design_spec.visual_hierarchy: Submit=btn-primary (blue), Approve=btn-success (green) for visual distinction as accountability checkpoint, Publish=btn-primary (blue). Also verify status color coding per design_spec.status_indicators.

acceptance_criteria.description: Draft plan without submitted_at shows 'Submit for Review' button (btn-primary/blue)
Draft plan with submitted_at shows 'Approve' button (btn-success/green per visual_hierarchy)
Approved plan shows 'Publish' button (btn-primary/blue)
